Definition: from G2095 and G5543; easily used, i.e. useful:--profitable, meet for use.
BiblicalUsage: eúchrēstos is the word for profitable, meet for use. In 2 Timothy 2:21, the text says "and meet for the master's use." In 2 Timothy 4:11, the text says "for he is profitable to me for the ministry."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that eúchrēstos matters because serving is not earning; it is answering love with love. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
